sub_answers.text: Early in his career he was known primarily as an elite defender and floor spacer rather than a primary creator [d31163849s20p0]. Scouts and analysts cited playmaking as a weakness, as he had never averaged more than 3.5 assists per game in his first eight seasons [d31163849s20p0]. He began taking on a larger offensive responsibility from the 2015–16 season and developed into one of the league's most efficient scorers, indicating the primary recurring criticism was his limited playmaking rather than shooting or defense [d31163849s20p0].
